name: vaiz
description: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to your Vaiz workspace: tasks, boards, documents, Space Memory, and GitHub links via remote MCP with OAuth.

interface.longDescription: Work with Vaiz tasks, boards, documents, milestones, Space Memory, files, workspace activity, and GitHub links through a hosted MCP server with OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Show my open Vaiz tasks and what needs attention.
Summarize the latest activity in my Vaiz project.
Create a Vaiz Devlog for the work completed today.

positive.description: List the signed-in user's open tasks
positive.prompt: Show my open Vaiz tasks and what needs attention.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the incomplete tasks assigned to the signed-in user with their HRIDs, boards, statuses, and due dates, highlighting overdue items.

positive.description: Create a task on a board
positive.prompt: Create a Vaiz task called "Prepare release notes" in the Demo project and assign it to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task on a board in the Demo project, assigns it to the signed-in user, and returns the new task HRID and link.

positive.prompt: Summarize the latest activity in my Vaiz Demo project.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes recent changes in the Demo project (created, moved, and completed tasks, comments) with who made them and when.

positive.prompt: Find the Vaiz document about onboarding and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the matching document in the space and returns a short summary of its content with the document title and link.

positive.description: Record a Devlog in Space Memory
positive.prompt: Create a Vaiz Devlog for the work completed today: fixed the login redirect bug and added tests.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a Devlog entry in Space Memory describing the completed work and returns its id.

negative.prompt: Pay my Vaiz subscription invoice with my saved card.

negative.description: Unsupported destructive action: delete the whole space
negative.prompt: Delete my entire Vaiz space and all its data.
Show me the tasks in a Vaiz space I am not a member of.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: Vaiz tasks, boards, documents, milestones, Space Memory, files, and GitHub links via the hosted Vaiz MCP server with OAuth.
